catalog.name: EmDash
catalog.summary: A full-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro, the spiritual successor to WordPress: this is its blog template, with posts, pages, categories and tags, search, RSS and an admin editor, on D1 and R2.
catalog.tagline: Create a blog with built-in search and an editor
features: Publish posts and pages from a rich text editor
Organize posts with categories and tags
Let readers search the full text of your posts
Publish an RSS feed readers can subscribe to
Save drafts and schedule posts to go live later

postInstall.content: Open {{appUrl}}/_emdash/admin right away to run the setup wizard and create the admin account; until then anyone who opens it can. The site itself is at {{appUrl}}.
